completed.summary: Phase 2 bugfixes (Coach-reported HIGH bugs): (1) isPreflopRoundComplete() fold-before-raise fix — added foldedPositions tracking, skipped folded positions in round-completion check. UTG fold → HJ raise → all call now correctly returns true. (2) advanceToNextStreet() timer cleanup — clears autoAdvanceRef at function start to prevent double-advance on manual button click + auto-advance timer race. 53/53 vitest pass, build clean.

Phase 1 of game tree fix: (1) Added isPreflopRoundComplete() detection — round ends when all positions after last raiser have called/folded (equal-action rule). (2) Auto-transition from preflop to postflop mode: generates flop cards, sets up postflop state without requiring manual mode toggle. (3) Added auto-advance timer in PostflopTraining: after user takes action and sees GTO feedback, auto-advances to next street after 1.5s. (4) Added isAllFold() detection (hand-over on all-fold). Remaining: all-in short-circuit to deal remaining streets automatically, and backend-driven round-complete detection.
